content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required 'High (즉시조치)' severity string was missing from the combined XML sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the environment setup and basic file generation worked, the output XML failed to include the mapped severity value required by the safety audit brief's overview section.
